data.description:
## What
Create `plugins/dso/scripts/mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh` implementing the `mirror_defenses_to_pr <ticket_id> <pr_number>` function. This GREEN task makes the RED integration test `test_mirror_defenses_idempotency` (task 9e3f-0544) pass.

## Bash function contract (from test 9e3f-0544)
```bash
# Source: plugins/dso/scripts/mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh
mirror_defenses_to_pr <ticket_id> <pr_number>
# Exit 0 on success (including when nothing to mirror)
# Idempotent: re-running produces same comment set, no duplicates
```

## Implementation requirements
1. Source `review-defense-store.sh` — use `defense_store_load <ticket_id>` to get all DEFENSE_RECORD comments
2. Source `review-github-defense-store.sh` — use `gh pr view <pr_number> --comments` to list existing PR comments
3. For each DEFENSE_RECORD from tracker:
   - Compute a deduplication key (e.g., first 80 chars of the record body)
   - Skip if a matching PR comment already exists (idempotency)
   - Otherwise: post as PR comment via `gh pr comment <pr_number> --body <record>`
4. Inter-batch delay: `sleep 1` between comment posts to respect GitHub secondary rate limits
5. Mirror failure must NOT propagate errors that block the llm-review job (soft failure: log to stderr, exit 0)

## Files to Create
- plugins/dso/scripts/mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh (new file, chmod +x)

## Acceptance Criteria
- test -x plugins/dso/scripts/mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh
- bash tests/integration/test-mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh exits 0 (test_mirror_defenses_idempotency passes)
- shellcheck --severity=warning plugins/dso/scripts/mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh exits 0

## Testing Mode
GREEN — makes test_mirror_defenses_idempotency (9e3f-0544) pass

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/mirror-defenses-to-pr.sh (create)
